subject: repaired WENO7 probe (positivity-preserving flux limiter) used as a same-family higher-order reference

repair.diagnosis: first inadmissible state occurs in SSP-RK stage 1 (p<0 one cell), i.e. the face-state positivity guard never sees a cell average
repair.mechanism: flux-level Zhang-Shu-style global-theta limiting of the WENO7 flux toward the first-order LLF flux; conservative (fluxes telescope) and terminating (theta=0 is the admissible CFL<=1/2 first-order step)
rejected_variants: state (theta) blending: not conservative (measured relative mass drift 5.5e-5 at nx=200)
whole-step dt halving retry: conservative, but stalls (dt fell to 9.1e-13 of nominal and the step was truncated at t<t_end) because the violation is spatial

criteria.S1_robustness: every rung step_status=='complete', admissible_final true, pp_failures==0, first_order_inadmissible==0, |mass_drift| <= 1e-12
criteria.S2_accuracy_preserved: entropy-wave observed order (limiter on) >= 5.0 at sizes [80,160,320,640,1280]; and the limiter is inert there (pp_limited_stages==0, theta_min==1.0)
criteria.S4_cross_order_shrinks: L1_window(rho7(nx) - rho5(nx)) observed order over 800->1600->3200 >= 0.5 and value at 3200 <= 1.0 %
criteria.S6_verdict_discipline: certified-<1 % status is NOT advanced in this round unless S1-S5 all PASS and the WENO7 self-convergence point estimate eps_ref7(3200) < 0.5 %; otherwise it stays False and the round reports WHITHHELD

declared_limitation: WENO7 shares the time integrator (SSP-RK3) and interface flux (Rusanov) with the WENO5 reference: it probes reconstruction order, not code independence
negative_control: pre-repair code path (positivity_limiter=False) at the rungs that diverged in round 6
supersedes_note: round-6 froze the hashes of wc_weno7.py / wc_weno7_ladder.py; this round-8 predeclaration supersedes them on purpose (see `repair`). The round-6 record itself is left byte-identical -- its own freeze forbids further amendments.
